status: NORMATIVE_DRAFT — binding for the program-owned repositories listed in scope from 2026-09-05 (DEC-AUP-0008 + AUP-E29/AUP-GRAPH-006). Enforced by tools/graph/admit_change.py locally; CI is a post-hoc gate (DEC-AUP-0007).
purpose: «Нет receipt — нет мержа». A change is admitted into a program-owned repository only when a ChangeAdmissionReceipt/v1 exists that is conformant, fresh, bound to exactly this change, whose every affected entity carries a tri-valued verdict, and whose admission verdict is admitted or admitted_with_exemptions. The receipt is evidence attached to the Work Item — never a status, never a checkbox in a pull-request description.
charter_rule_text: Проверка изменения кода по умолчанию — graph-verified change: обновить/проверить свежесть графа связей, вычислить множество влияния, исполнить обязательные верификаторы для каждой затронутой сущности, выдать receipt с тривалентными вердиктами. Тесты — выбираемый верификатор, TDD — opt-in клиентских пространств. Граф выбирает проверку, он её не заменяет: пустое множество влияния — предсказание, требующее объяснения, не одобрение.
charter_rule_text_en: The default verification of a code change is graph-verified change: refresh/check the freshness of the relationship graph, compute the impact set, run the mandatory verifiers for every affected entity, and issue a receipt with tri-valued verdicts. Tests are a selectable verifier; TDD is opt-in for client spaces. The graph selects the verification, it never replaces it: an empty impact set is a prediction that requires an explanation, not an approval.

scope.documentation_only_changes: still need a receipt; a documentation-only change may carry an empty impact set ONLY with change_set kinds all in (doc, receipt) — otherwise EMPTY_IMPACT_WITHOUT_EXPLANATION applies (schema rule)
scope.out_of_scope: repositories that are not program-owned (prompt-assembly, model-connector, arcana-agent-system and every operator-fleet repo): the gate may be run for information, never as a merge condition, until their owners adopt it
scope.ci_scope_rule: `ci_required_repositories` are the repositories where the `graph-admission` job is a REQUIRED-for-merge check. `ci_proposed_repositories` carry a proposal pull request that adds the same job as NON-required (dark launch): the owner's broker decides promotion, and per AUP-GRAPH-009's method clause a repository is promoted only after a GRAPH-007 mutation calibration of its own language/population. A repository being here is never by itself a merge condition.

gate_verdicts.paused_safe: exit 3 — merge blocked, the missing measurement is named; PAUSED_SAFE beats guessing (DEC-AUP-0008 I4)

checks.rule: A bypass marker (--skip-receipt, env AUP_SKIP_RECEIPT/AUP_ADMIT_BYPASS, or a bypass phrase in the change description) refuses before any receipt lookup. A gate bypassed by a flag is not a gate (AUP-GRAPH-008 failure condition: «гейт обходится флагом без исключения в реестре»). The only lawful relaxation is an exemption inside the receipt, with owner and expiry.

A change description that claims graph verification with a checkbox or a prose marker («[x] graph-verified», «verified: yes», «tests pass») while no ChangeAdmissionReceipt/v1 covers the change is refused with this dedicated code — the card's first failure condition («receipt заменён чекбоксом в описании PR»).
No ChangeAdmissionReceipt/v1 in the search paths is bound to this change range.
tools/graph/schema_check.py classifies the receipt as violation; the violation codes are carried into the gate receipt verbatim.

In diff mode the receipt's change_set.head must be a commit of the gated range (base..head) and change_set.base must be an ancestor of the range head; a receipt produced for another branch or another repository never admits this one.

Every file changed in the gated range must appear in the union of the change_set of the bound receipts. Uncovered paths are listed in the gate receipt — a receipt that describes a subset of the change is not a receipt for the change.
staleness.verdict must be fresh. stale ⇒ refuse; not_checked ⇒ refuse (the graph selected nothing that can be trusted).
Any affected entity with verdict failed and without an admissible exemption refuses the change.
Any affected entity with verdict not_measured and without an admissible exemption pauses the change: not_measured is a third verdict, never read as pass (DEC-AUP-0008 I4).
An exemption without an owner, without an expiry, expired at the gate's clock, or naming an entity that has no verdict is inadmissible; the entity it claims to cover falls back to its raw verdict.
The receipt's own admission.verdict must be admitted or admitted_with_exemptions; refused ⇒ refuse, paused_safe ⇒ paused_safe. The gate never upgrades a receipt's verdict, it may only lower it.

An impact entry on a service boundary reached over an inferred or observed edge requires a canary entry (AUP-GRAPH-008); the schema rule is re-applied at the gate so that a receipt written before the canary tooling cannot be merged silently.

The receipt must be attached to a Work Item as an evidence attachment (WorkItemEvidenceAttachment/v1) — receipt.work_item plus a ledger entry whose digest matches the receipt bytes. Enforcement level is work_item_evidence.enforcement below.

enforcement_values.off: the attachment is not required (never used in a program-owned repository)
enforcement_values.ledger: an entry in the program-side evidence ledger is required; the delivery to Muneral is recorded with its own tri-valued status
enforcement_values.muneral: an accepted Muneral evidence attachment is required (enable once a work-item evidence route exists for agent keys)

evidence_ref.rule: shape and bounds of Muneral's EvidenceRef (apps/api/src/execution-authority/evidence-ref.validator.ts): uri ≤ 512 chars, digest sha256:<64 hex> of the receipt bytes, contentType from Muneral's allowed set (application/json for a ChangeAdmissionReceipt), label ≤ 128 chars, ≤ 64 refs per command — so a ledger entry can be posted verbatim the day a route exists

attachment_schema.never_status: The attachment carries evidence only. Writing a Work Item status or a transition to represent 'verified' is forbidden by this policy and by the card ('не как статус'); tools/graph/admit_change.py never calls a status or transition route.

delivery.rule: status not_measured requires reason_code and a probe record; a delivery that was never attempted is never recorded as posted

muneral.auth: agent key (mun_sk_) from the host's protected secrets — never in git, never printed
muneral.finding: MUNERAL_NO_WORK_ITEM_EVIDENCE_ROUTE — the deployed API has no work-item evidence-attachment surface reachable by an agent key. The routes that do accept evidenceRefs with an agent key are POST /migration/work-items/:taskId/transitions (a transition — excluded by this policy: evidence must not be written as a status) and POST /tasks/:taskId/attempts/:attemptId/solution-log-heads (digest-only, bound to an execution attempt). Recorded, not worked around: the ledger holds the attachment in the shape Muneral's EvidenceRef validator accepts, and delivery stays not_measured until the route exists.
muneral.follow_up: MUN work item: POST /tasks/:taskId/evidence (ApiKeyGuard, EvidenceRef body, append-only, no status side effect) — proposed by AUP-GRAPH-006, owner Muneral (MUN); until then enforcement stays 'ledger'.

tdd_policy.default: graph-verified change (this policy). Tests are a SELECTABLE verifier, bound to an edge type by contracts/graph-verified-change/verifier-matrix.v1.json — never mandatory 'just in case'.
tdd_policy.opt_in: A space opts in with `verification_policy: tdd-required` in spaces/<name>/space.yml; the TDD skill stays in the knowledge base as an opt-in discipline for client spaces.
tdd_policy.not_a_ban: The rule is never read as 'tests are forbidden'. A change may add or run any test; a failing targeted test still fails the entity it covers.

classification.opt_in_reference: a line that names TDD as opt-in / client-space-scoped / a knowledge-base skill
classification.neutral_mention: a line that names TDD without prescribing it (a marker string, a historical note, a description of another project's practice) — recorded, not a violation

ci_gate.status: NORMATIVE_DRAFT — required in ci_required_repositories from 2026-09-06 (AUP-GRAPH-006:gate1); proposed (non-required, dark launch) in ci_proposed_repositories from 2026-09-06; post-hoc by DEC-AUP-0007.

verdict_mapping.not_measured (doc-only change): green — stated in the check text as `not_measured`, never as a pass

receipt_sources: files in the pull-request head tree matching the caller's receipt globs (default receipts/graph/**/*.json and receipts/**/change-admission-*.json)
a fenced ```json block in the pull-request body whose schema starts with ChangeAdmissionReceipt — read from a file, never interpolated into a shell command
ci_gate.doc_only_rule: A change whose every path matches doc_only_globs is reported `not_measured` and green: the gate measured NOTHING about code, so it claims nothing. This is the CI mapping only — it does NOT waive the local rule in scope.documentation_only_changes, where a documentation-only change still carries a receipt whose change_set kinds are all in (doc, receipt).

tools_delivery.mechanism: vendored bundle GraphAdmissionBundle/v1 under the caller's .github/graph-admission/, produced by `tools/graph/ci_gate.py bundle` from one pinned program-repo SHA
tools_delivery.why: the program repository is private: a caller repository's GITHUB_TOKEN cannot check it out, and this portion creates no shared credential. Vendoring keeps the binding promise — the gate runs the code of ONE pinned SHA, never `main` — without inventing a secret.
tools_delivery.integrity: the workflow refuses unless every bundled file's sha256 matches BUNDLE.json and the caller's program_ref input equals the bundle's program_ref; a pull request that touches anything under the bundle directory is refused (BUNDLE_MODIFIED_BY_PR) — a bundle refresh is its own gated pull request.
tools_delivery.known_hole: a pull request that rewrites BOTH a bundled tool and BUNDLE.json in ONE commit is refused by BUNDLE_MODIFIED_BY_PR, but nothing cryptographically binds the bundle to the program repository — CI is post-hoc (DEC-AUP-0007) and the local gate remains the authority. Closing it needs either a read credential for the private program repository or a signed bundle; recorded as an open hole, not a solved problem.

graph_build.decision: BUILD in CI, do not commit a graph into the caller repository.
graph_build.why: a committed graph is a generated 10^4-line artefact in a product repository that is stale the moment anything merges, and its freshness check IS the build. The builder is stdlib-only and deterministic (muneral: 429 nodes / 1684 edges in ~0.9 s), so CI rebuilds the caller's graph at the receipt's graph.source_commit and compares graph_digest with the digest the receipt was produced against — GRAPH_DIGEST_MISMATCH is red. That is a stronger statement than freshness: it proves the receipt was computed against this code.
graph_build.not_measured_cases: a receipt that names no graph source_commit/digest, or a build that fails, is recorded as not_measured (GRAPH_NOT_REBUILT / GRAPH_BUILD_FAILED) — never as a pass.

pinned_program_ref.used_by: the seven card-3 dark-launch proposals (their vendored bundles and their `program_ref` input)
pinned_program_ref.why_not_main: a caller must run the gate tools of ONE pinned SHA, never a moving branch (DEC-AUP-0008); the SHA is recorded in BUNDLE.json and re-checked by the job.
pinned_program_ref.note: Arcanada-one/muneral still pins cdc9ee682821edc53c98f40c025aba6935b6f621 — self-consistent (its bundle digests match what it carries) and working; a refresh there is its own gated pull request.

workflow_audit.rule: the reusable workflow must pass `zizmor --persona auditor --min-severity high` and `actionlint`, because a vendored copy lands in repositories that run those audits in CI (prompt-assembly gates its delivery-integrity aggregate on them). A proposal that reddens the receiving repository's security gate is damage, not a proposal.
workflow_audit.how: no `${{ … }}` expansion inside a `run:` block — every value arrives through `env:`. `python3 tools/graph/wf_extract_run.py <workflow> <step-id> <out> --assert-no-expansions` is the local check, and it doubles as the precondition for replaying a step outside GitHub.
workflow_audit.measured_2026-09-06: 4 high template-injection findings before the fix (inputs.build_graph, inputs.tools_path, inputs.program_ref, inputs.enforcement); 0 after, in all seven caller repositories; the added file contributes no actionlint finding either.
